player_intro: posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in January 2002.
notes: The byline is a prank name and the handle is an ASCII rude gesture, so neither is shown in the page title or the Player field; the original post below keeps the byline as published.
A self-described joke deck ('Ok Ok this a stupid deck'); published as the author's last DeckTech post.
The DeckTech tag says Light and every card is Light; the draft's Dark side was corrected.
Starting (6) as posted: Rendezvous Point, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Brisky Morning Munchen; these count toward the 60.
Posted misspellings: 'rendevouse point' dested Rendezvous Point, 'anikans podracer' Anakin's Podracer, 'brisky morning munching' Brisky Morning Munchen, 'I Did It' I Did It!.
'Purple cards(1)' is a section header (Epic Events), not a card.
Jar Jar's Electropole is posted once under 'Weapons(52)', so the section count of 52 is kept as published (the card is unique, so the list is not legal); the total is 60.
The byline 'Middle ",,I,,oo,,I,," Fingers' is a prank name, so no player page; the handle is an ASCII middle-finger gesture.
